confidence_classes.STAMPED: at least one stamped evidence edge, one edge type

note: Scalar rule table for the reasoning bridge (census C-224). Each rule converts stamped context scalars from registered signals' stamped homes (situational graph edges in v1) into ONE directional premise. Band tables band the scalar's OWN extremity (days, feet above the graph's own threshold) — they are descriptive bands of the input fact, never fitted effect sizes, and no rule emits a probability, a pick, or a score.

rules.crosswalk_note: partial: the registry signals' own evaluators read env keys with zero production writers (registry.json evidence); the graph's rest_differential edge is the first stamped home for the rest scalar they name
rules.direction: scalar > 0 -> FAVORS_HOME; scalar < 0 -> FAVORS_AWAY; scalar == 0 -> NEUTRAL

rules.crosswalk_note: the registry signal's evaluator reads unwritten env keys; the graph's altitude edge (venue_static source) is its first stamped home
rules.direction: visitor burden -> AGAINST_AWAY when the altitude edge runs team -> venue for the visiting team
rules.scalar: value.venue_elevation_ft - value.threshold_ft (feet above the graph's own altitude threshold), only when value.at_altitude is true

bands.condition: otherwise, when the composite edge exists

rules.crosswalk_note: the fleet's canonical composite (Reasoning Doctrine / WO-0 read): altitude on a short week is recorded as variance/friction on the visitor, NOT as a mean shift — so this rule's direction is FRICTION with the burden named on the visitor
rules.direction: FRICTION (burden on the visiting team named in the premise subject)
rules.scalar: value.venue_elevation_ft and value.visitor_rest_days from the composite edge

rules.crosswalk_note: fires when BOTH teams carry SHORT_WEEK for the game; preparation compression is a game-level friction fact and takes no side
rules.scalar: rest_days on each team's SHORT_WEEK has_state edge

rules.crosswalk_note: partial: the registry signal is a tendencies construct; the graph's coaching_change edge is the stamped tenure fact available in v1
